item.title: Serbian war criminal Mladic to be buried with 'state honours'
item.description: Convicted genocidaire Ratko Mladić has died at the age of 84 in a UN prison in The Hague, where he was serving a life sentence. item.title: Relocated turtle nests produced fewer hatchlings, smaller young and a heavily female-biased sex ratio
item.description: Relocating vulnerable sea turtle nests can lead to unexpected negative consequences. When nests are moved to warmer areas, the sex ratio of hatchlings skews heavily towards females. Additionally, even nests placed in shaded locations yield smaller hatchlings with reduced physical capabilities. Therefore, effective nest relocation must consider various environmental factors beyond just temperature to ensure the successful recovery of turtle populations. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
